description: Add or update canonical vocabulary terms. Terms nest as { "term-slug": { "en": "…", "tr": "…" } } — the OUTER key is the term, the INNER key is a locale. Merges with the existing vocabulary: a term you omit is untouched. Changes are auto-committed to git — do NOT manually edit .contentrain/vocabulary.json.

terms.description: Terms keyed by kebab-case term slug, each holding its translations keyed by locale code. Example: { "sign-in": { "en": "Sign in", "tr": "Giriş yap" } }

name: contentrain_vocabulary_save
